viewUpcoming.question: How do I view upcoming events?
viewUpcoming.answer: On your dashboard, the Upcoming Events card shows the next published events. Select the yellow arrow next to its title to see every upcoming event, then select an event to read its details.

registrationStatus.question: How can I check my registration status?
registrationStatus.answer: Open Events from the sidebar. Each registration shows its status — Pending, Need to Confirm, Accepted, Declined, Attended, Not Attended, or Cancelled. Select a registration to see its details, confirm or cancel it when that's available, and view your attendance ticket.

registeredEvents.question: Where can I find events I've registered for?
registeredEvents.answer: Events in the sidebar opens My Events, which lists every event and trip you registered for. Use the Upcoming, Past and All tabs, the status and type filters, or search. The colored cards on your dashboard show your next registrations.

findTasks.question: Where can I find my assigned tasks?
findTasks.answer: Select Tasks from the sidebar. You can switch between Board and List views and filter your tasks by priority. The My Tasks section on your dashboard also shows a summary.

taskStatuses.question: What do the task statuses mean?
taskStatuses.answer: To Do means the task hasn't been started. In Progress means it's being worked on. Complete means it's finished. The Board view groups your tasks into these three columns.

taskProblem.question: What should I do if I have a problem with a task?
taskProblem.answer: The Tasks page is read-only for members, so task details and statuses are updated by your committee leadership. If a task is unclear, blocked, or assigned by mistake, contact your committee leader directly.

committeeInfo.question: How do I find my committee information?
committeeInfo.answer: Open Settings from the sidebar. The My Profile & Committee section shows your name, committee, and role.

editCommittee.question: Why can't I edit my committee details?
editCommittee.answer: Committee information and administrative settings are managed by authorized committee leadership. Members can view their committee details but can't change them. If something is wrong, ask your committee leader to update it.

memberVsLeader.question: What is the difference between Member and Leader access?
memberVsLeader.answer: Members can view their registrations, upcoming events, and assigned tasks, and manage their own preferences. Leaders use a separate leader workspace to manage their committee's events, members, tasks, points, and committee settings.

changeNotifications.question: How do I change my notification preferences?
changeNotifications.answer: Open Settings and use the toggles under Notification Preferences. Each change is saved automatically in this browser — there's no Save button.

toggleUpdates.question: How do I enable or disable certain updates?
toggleUpdates.answer: Each toggle controls one type of update: new tasks, task deadline reminders, task updates, new events, and registration updates. Turn a toggle off to opt out of that update, or on to opt back in.

notReceiving.question: Why am I not receiving notifications?
notReceiving.answer: Notification delivery isn't connected yet, so no emails or alerts are sent at the moment. Your preferences are saved in this browser and will be used once notifications are available. Until then, check My Events and Tasks for the latest updates.
